d: Jet black hair is hidden beneath a white mask, leaving only a few stray strands. Pale gold eyes peer through narrow slits of a white porcelain mask. The face is completely obscured, appearing as a mature, disciplined warrior. The build is tall and athletic. The signature outfit is a flowing white kimono with a high collar and gold accents, worn over a dark underlayer. Signature details include a large white mask with a red mark on the forehead and a massive own-sized white odachi.
